headline: Executive order aimed at preventing violence against federal, state, tribal, and local law enforcement officers.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Donald Trump on February 9, 2017, deals with preventing violence against law enforcement officers at every level of government. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires, and which agencies must take them, cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Federal, state, tribal, and local law enforcement officers
who_it_affects.how: The order is focused on protecting these officers from violence, though its specific measures are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 9, 2017; the available material does not state a separate start date.
